page.overview:
What is Victreebel?

Victreebel's body greatly resembles its pre-evolution Weepinbell, having a yellow bulbous head with dark green spots. It also sports two eyes close to its large mouth, which has a pink tip that resembles lips. It has two green leaves at the sides of its body. Inside its mouth are two fangs. A brown vine is also connected to the back of its body which sports a yellow bulb on one end and a large leaf covering its mouth on the other.

Mega Victreebel lost its ability to lure in prey with scent and now relies on brute force to take down its target via powerful body tackles.

Victreebel lure their prey in by emitting a sweet scent. When the Pokémon goes inside Victreebel's mouth, it is swallowed whole.

Mega Victreebel's acid is greatly enhanced and is strong enough to melt steel and concrete. Because of the excess amount of acid, Mega Victreebel has to wrap its neck tight to prevent the acid from pouring out. The scent Mega Victreebel creates now can cause dizziness to anyone nearby.
